title: Aft Fuselage & Engine Nacelles
summary: High-temperature titanium-intensive aft fuselage enclosing the side-by-side twin F119 engine bays and supporting the empennage.
role: Houses the twin powerplants, carries tail loads, and withstands thermal exposure near the exhaust bays.
materials: Predominantly titanium alloy structure and heat-resistant frames.
